verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's workspace model lets power users configure distinct prompts, models, and agent skills per workspace (docs-9, docs-15, docs-16, docs-22), which supports running multiple distinct agent configurations. However, there is no concrete evidence of explicit conversation/channel routing logic directing traffic to specific agents beyond manually picking a workspace. Missing for 10: evidence of automated routing/dispatch between agents or channels, and independent confirmation of multi-agent orchestration in practice.
